dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of valid runs with m rows and n columns. Its constructor packages a floating-point format, n ≤ m, 0 < n, matrices A and LHat of size m by n, a matrix UHat of size n by n, structural and representability conditions, and certified executions computing the relevant entries of LHat and UHat.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The theorem is universally quantified over these packaged runs, so all conclusions are restricted to data satisfying the constructor conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.A, a real m-by-n matrix indexed by Fin m and Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the input matrix appearing in both local residual bounds and in the backward-error identity LHat UHat = A + ΔA.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.LHat, a real m-by-n matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the computed unit lower-trapezoidal factor used in all partial sums, the matrix product, and the componentwise bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.UHat, a real n-by-n matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the computed upper-triangular factor used in all partial sums, the matrix product, and the componentwise bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection run.format, the floating-point format associated with the run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target obtains the unit roundoff from this format; the format also restricts which runs and execution certificates can exist.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every run, this theorem supplies the packaged inequality n ≤ m.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits each column index k < n to be regarded as the row index with the same natural value in Fin m.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: The unit-roundoff projection of a floating-point format, a real number denoted u.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the error-scale factor in every stated bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: For matrices L and U, LocalDef008(L,U,i,j,k) equals Σ_{r<k}|L_{ir}||U_{rj}| + |L_{ik}||U_{kj}|, hence the absolute-product prefix sum through index k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the nonnegative magnitude term multiplying k u or (k+1)u in the two local residual bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: For matrices L and U, LocalDef009(L,U,i,j,k) equals Σ_{r<k}L_{ir}U_{rj} + L_{ik}U_{kj}, hence the signed product prefix sum through index k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The local residuals compare entries of A with this exact partial matrix-product sum.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: For matrices L and U, LocalDef010(L,U,i,j) is the full sum Σ_{r=0}^{n-1}|L_{ir}||U_{rj}|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the componentwise absolute matrix product |LHat||UHat| used in every bound on ΔA.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: For matrices L and U, LocalDef011(L,U,i,j) is the full matrix-product entry Σ_{r=0}^{n-1}L_{ir}U_{rj}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The existential conclusion identifies this matrix product with A + ΔA.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: Given n ≤ m, it embeds Fin n into Fin m without changing the underlying natural index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies the kth column index with the kth row when referring to diagonal entries and the kth row of A or LHat.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for a run requires n ≤ m and 0 < n; representability of every entry of A, LHat, and UHat; LHat_{kk}=1 on the first n rows; LHat_{ij}=0 when i<j; UHat_{ij}=0 when j<i; certified UHat computations for k≤j; and certified LHat computations for k<i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These are the intrinsic hypotheses hidden in the binder run. In particular, the factors are unit lower-trapezoidal and upper-triangular and arise from certified floating-point executions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of floating-point formats constructed by LocalDef019, carrying radix, precision, exponent limits, representability and safe-range predicates, rounding, unit roundoff, and their axioms.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the numerical model under which runs are certified and supplies the unit roundoff used explicitly in the bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef015(L,U,i,j,k) is Σ_{s:Fin(k)}|L_{i,s}||U_{s,j}|, equivalently the sum over natural indices 0≤s<k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the kth absolute product, it forms the inclusive prefix magnitude LocalDef008.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef016(L,U,i,j,k) is Σ_{s:Fin(k)}L_{i,s}U_{s,j}, equivalently the signed sum over 0≤s<k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the kth product, it forms the inclusive partial product LocalDef009.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: A certificate that an entry LHat_{ik}, with k<i, was produced by an execution whose inputs are the preceding row products, whose right divisor is UHat_{kk}, whose initial value is A_{ik}, and whose output is LHat_{ik}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every lower-factor entry covered by the second local bound is required by the run to have such a certified floating-point computation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: A certificate that an entry UHat_{kj}, with k≤j, was produced by an execution using the preceding products from row k, divisor 1, initial value A_{kj}, and output UHat_{kj}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every upper-factor entry covered by the first local bound is required by the run to have such a certified floating-point computation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: The format constructor requires radix β≥2, positive precision p, ordered exponent limits, a finite representable set characterized by bounded integer significands and exponents, safe-range and rounding operations, 0≤u≤1/2 with u·2·β^(p-1)=1, representability of 0 and 1 and closure under negation, correctly rounded safe-range values, a relative rounding bound |round(x)-x|≤u|round(x)|, preservation of nonnegativity, a square-root error axiom, and exact rounding of representable values.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts admissible formats and ensures that the explicit u is a genuine unit roundoff; its rounding and safe-range axioms also underlie the packaged execution certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: The representability predicate of a floating-point format.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Run matrices, execution inputs, and intermediate leaves are required to be representable, although representability is not repeated in the target conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: For k:Fin n and s:Fin(k.val), it embeds s into Fin n with unchanged value, so its image consists of indices strictly below k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the strict-prefix sums and execution inputs range exactly over 0,…,k-1.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor of an L-entry certificate identifies an execution of length k with a_s=LHat_{is}, b_s=UHat_{sk}, bK=UHat_{kk}, c=A_{ik}, and yHat=LHat_{ik}, using indices s<k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects the abstract execution model to each computed lower-factor entry appearing in the second residual estimate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor of a U-entry certificate identifies an execution of length k with a_s=LHat_{ks}, b_s=UHat_{sj}, bK=1, c=A_{kj}, and yHat=UHat_{kj}, using indices s<k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects the abstract execution model to each computed upper-factor entry appearing in the first residual estimate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: It proves that if s<k and k<n, then s<n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It justifies the index embedding used for strict-prefix sums and has no additional mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of a certified rounded dot-update-and-optional-division execution of length m, constructed by LocalDef032.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These executions are the computational witnesses packaged inside the LHat and UHat entry certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: The execution projection a, a real vector indexed by Fin m.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is identified with the relevant entries of LHat in each local factor computation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: The execution projection b, a real vector indexed by Fin m.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is identified with the relevant entries of UHat in each local factor computation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: The execution projection bK, the nonzero divisor.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is 1 for UHat computations and UHat_{kk} for LHat computations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: The execution projection c, the initial real value in the dot-update.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is identified with the corresponding entry of A.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: The floating-point format projection of an execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Entry certificates require it to equal the run's format.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: The execution projection yHat, the final computed result.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is identified with the relevant entry of LHat or UHat.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: This execution constructor requires representable a_i, b_i, bK, and c; bK≠0; safe exact products a_i b_i; a binary summation tree and permutation; representable leaves and safe internal additions; a numerator obtained by rounded tree summation of c and the values -round(a_i b_i); an inductive summation-error certificate for that numerator; and an output equal to the numerator when bK=1 or to round(numerator/bK), with safe division, when bK≠1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It specifies the floating-point computations underlying all certified factor entries, including product rounding, arbitrary summation order/tree, and optional rounded division.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: The rounding-function projection of a floating-point format.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines rounded products, additions, divisions, and square roots in the execution model but does not occur explicitly in the final inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: The safe-range predicate of a floating-point format.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Certified executions require relevant products, additions, and divisions to lie in this range; the final proposition does not assert bounds outside certified runs.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: An inductively generated proposition certifying a rounded summation with a term count, a pivot value, an exact remaining sum, an absolute-sum bound, and a computed result, using the base and composition rules D040 and D041.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Executions must provide this certificate for their rounded numerator, enabling the local error estimates encoded in the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of nonempty binary trees indexed by their number of leaves: one-leaf trees and nodes combining sizes m and n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits arbitrary binary association of the m+1 summands in each certified execution.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: It forms a vector of m+1 summands whose first entry is c and whose successor entry i is -round(a_i b_i).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the vector permuted and rounded-summed to produce an execution numerator approximating c-Σ_i a_i b_i.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: It evaluates a leaf-labelled binary tree: a leaf returns its sole value, and a node returns round(left evaluation + right evaluation).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the computed rounded numerator for an execution's chosen tree and permutation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: It recursively requires each leaf value to be representable and each child condition to hold, and requires the sum of the two computed child values at every node to be in the format's safe range.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures that every rounded addition used by the execution is legitimate in the floating-point model.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: The base summation certificate: a representable pivot certifies a one-term computation with exact remainder 0, absolute remainder 0, and computed result equal to the pivot.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the base case for the execution's summation-error certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: The composition rule adds a positive-size sibling block whose computed value has error at most siblingCount·u·siblingAbs, rounds pivotValue+siblingComputed in safe range, and combines this with an outer certificate; counts, exact sums, and absolute bounds are added.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It inductively accounts for rounding errors in arbitrary summation trees used by executions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a tree and a motive, it recursively packages motive evidence and corresponding packages for the tree's proper subtrees; a leaf carries only unit data.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is internal infrastructure for strong structural induction over summation trees and adds no numerical condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: A strong tree-induction operator that applies a supplied function to the root together with the recursively packaged subtree evidence.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the definitions of rounded tree evaluation and safety without changing their mathematical content.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: The one-leaf binary tree, of size 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the leaf case for execution summation trees.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: The binary-node constructor combining a tree with m leaves and one with n leaves into a tree with m+n leaves.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies arbitrary binary association of execution summands.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef046(fmt,a,b,i) is round(a_i b_i).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines each rounded product subtracted in the execution numerator.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: The proof of the natural-number fact 0<1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constructs the sole Fin 1 index and has no substantive numerical effect.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent case eliminator for leaf-labelled binary trees, with one clause for a leaf and one for a node.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements recursive tree functions used by execution semantics.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef049
dependency_coverage.meaning: A tree recursion returning both motive evidence at the root and the recursively assembled package of subtree evidence.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements strong tree induction and contributes no extra mathematical assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef050
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent structural case eliminator for binary trees, with leaf and node branches.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is implementation infrastructure for D048 and does not alter the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef051
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary dependent recursor for binary trees, with a leaf case and a node case receiving both recursive hypotheses.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the recursive execution definitions and has no independent effect on the target.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires all two local bound families and the entire existential backward-error conclusion simultaneously.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the matrix-function identity LHat UHat = A+ΔA and the condition m=n, as well as identities inside run certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It asserts the existence of one perturbation matrix ΔA satisfying the identity and all associated bounds simultaneously.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin q is the finite index type consisting of natural numbers 0,…,q-1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes zero-based row, column, and summation index ranges and makes some quantified families empty when their antecedents cannot hold.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.val
dependency_coverage.meaning: The underlying natural number of a finite index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies all index comparisons and the exact integer coefficients k, k+1, and i in the bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the supplied instances it denotes natural addition, real addition, or pointwise matrix addition as appropriate.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With real instances it forms scalar products, matrix-product summands, and products of error coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes ordinary real subtraction in residuals and truncated natural subtraction in n-1.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched non-strict order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes the usual ≤ relation on natural numbers and real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched strict order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes the usual natural-number < relation in index restrictions and format assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural numbers, including zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The dimensions and all finite-index values are natural numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical cast of a natural number into a target type, here principally the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It turns k, k+1, n, i, and n-1 into exact real coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interpretation of a natural-number literal in a type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the literal 1 in k+1 and n-1 and literals used in supporting definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Addition of functions is defined pointwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Thus A+ΔA means the matrix with entry A_{ij}+ΔA_{ij}.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, perturbations, sums, absolute values, and error bounds are real-valued.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets additions in partial sums, matrix products, and A+ΔA.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive-group structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports real negation, subtraction, and the absolute-value definition.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual order ≤ on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every displayed error statement is an ordinary real inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets factor products and scalar error coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard embedding of natural numbers into the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the exact real values of all natural coefficients in the bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real subtraction, defined as addition of the negation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms every local residual and every rounding error.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.lattice
dependency_coverage.meaning: The lattice order structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the absolute-value operation.

dependency_coverage.name: abs
dependency_coverage.meaning: In an ordered additive group, abs(a)=max(a,-a); for real numbers this is the usual absolute value |a|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All errors are bounded componentwise in absolute value, and all magnitude sums use absolute factor entries.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary addition on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets k+1 and tree-size additions.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: It lifts a homogeneous Add operation to homogeneous HAdd notation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes addition notation to natural, real, and pointwise function addition.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: It lifts a homogeneous Mul operation to homogeneous HMul notation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes multiplication notation to ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: It lifts a homogeneous Sub operation to homogeneous HSub notation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes subtraction notation to real subtraction or natural truncated subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: instLENat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual ≤ relation on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses n≤m and the local restriction k≤j.

dependency_coverage.name: instLTNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual < relation on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses 0<n, triangularity conditions, and the local restriction k<i.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: A natural-number literal n denotes n itself.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the natural literals 0 and 1 without changing their values.

dependency_coverage.name: instSubNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Natural subtraction truncated at zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The square-case coefficient n-1 is formally truncated subtraction; because every run has 0<n, it is the ordinary predecessor of n.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.castLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: Given n≤m, it embeds Fin n into Fin m while preserving the underlying natural value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the row-index embedding used on the first n rows.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical finite enumeration of Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes sums over all indices of Fin n finite sums over 0,…,n-1.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: Finite summation in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines all signed and absolute matrix-product sums.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite set of all elements of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For Fin q it makes each sum range over every index 0,…,q-1.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive commutative-monoid structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives finite real sums their ordinary order-independent mathematical meaning.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: It interprets the literal 1 using a type's multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real 1 in the run and execution conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real number 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the unit diagonal value of LHat and the divisor in UHat computations.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real number 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in triangular zero conditions, format axioms, and base error certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: It interprets the literal 0 using a type's zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies ordinary zero values in the supporting definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: It extracts division from a division-inverse monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies ordinary real division in format and execution definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toZPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: It supplies integer powers in a division-inverse monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets real radix powers with integer exponents in the format's representability characterization.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.mk
dependency_coverage.meaning: It constructs a finite index from a natural value together with a proof that the value is below the bound.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the index embeddings used in prefix sums and tree evaluation.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched division.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it forms numerator/bK in LHat computations and constants in format axioms.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched exponentiation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses radix powers and squared rounded square roots in the format axioms.

dependency_coverage.name: Int
dependency_coverage.meaning: The integers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Integer significands and exponent limits are part of the floating-point format model, indirectly restricting admissible runs.

dependency_coverage.name: Int.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical cast of an integer into a target type, here the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets integer significands as real numbers in representable values.

dependency_coverage.name: Int.instLEInt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual ≤ relation on integers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It bounds representable exponents between the format's minimum and maximum.

dependency_coverage.name: Int.instLTInt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual < relation on integers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires the minimum exponent to be strictly below the maximum exponent.

dependency_coverage.name: Int.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary integer subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the shifted exponent e-(p-1) in the representability characterization.

dependency_coverage.name: Int.natAbs
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural absolute value of an integer.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It bounds the magnitude of a representable value's integer significand by β^p.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: It supplies natural-number exponentiation in a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets radix^precision and real powers with natural exponents in format conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instAtLeastTwoHAddOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: It proves that n+1 is at least two when n is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is typeclass infrastructure for interpreting certain successor-valued numerals and has no independent mathematical effect.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative monoid structure of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural powers such as radix^precision.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instNeZeroSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: It proves every successor n+1 is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports numeral and power infrastructure without adding a target hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: Neg.neg
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched additive negation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it forms negative rounded products and ordinary subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: Or
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical disjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the format characterization that a representable number is either zero or has the specified significand-exponent form.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real multiplicative structure supplying multiplication, inversion, division, and integer powers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets divisions and integer radix powers in the supporting floating-point model.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instIntCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard embedding of integers into the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives integer significands and exponents their ordinary real interpretation.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative monoid structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural real powers in format axioms.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNeg
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real negation.

binders: m and n are arbitrary natural numbers.
run is an arbitrary valid run of dimensions m by n. Write A=run.A, LHat=run.LHat, UHat=run.UHat, and u=run.format.unitRoundoff.
Rows of A and LHat are indexed by i∈{0,…,m-1}; their columns and both indices of UHat are indexed by {0,…,n-1}.
The perturbation witness ΔA, when introduced, is a real m-by-n matrix and may depend on the entire run.
hypotheses: The run intrinsically includes n≤m and 0<n.
Every entry of A, LHat, and UHat is representable in the packaged floating-point format.
Using the index-preserving inclusion κ:{0,…,n-1}→{0,…,m-1}, LHat_{κ(k),k}=1 for every k; LHat_{ij}=0 whenever i<j; and UHat_{ij}=0 whenever j<i.
For every k≤j, UHat_{kj} has a certified floating-point execution based on A_{κ(k),j} and the preceding products LHat_{κ(k),r}UHat_{rj}, r<k, with divisor 1.
For every k<i, LHat_{ik} has a certified floating-point execution based on A_{ik} and the preceding products LHat_{ir}UHat_{rk}, r<k, with nonzero divisor UHat_{kk}.
The packaged format has unit roundoff u satisfying its format axioms, including 0≤u≤1/2 and u·2·β^(p-1)=1, and each certified execution satisfies its representability and safe-range requirements.
The first local conclusion is conditional on k≤j; the second is conditional on k<i; and the sharper perturbation bounds are conditional on m=n.
conclusions: For every k,j∈{0,…,n-1} with k≤j, |A_{κ(k),j} - Σ_{r=0}^{k} LHat_{κ(k),r}UHat_{rj}| ≤ k·u·Σ_{r=0}^{k}|LHat_{κ(k),r}||UHat_{rj}|.
For every i∈{0,…,m-1} and k∈{0,…,n-1} with k<i, |A_{ik} - Σ_{r=0}^{k}LHat_{ir}UHat_{rk}| ≤ (k+1)·u·Σ_{r=0}^{k}|LHat_{ir}||UHat_{rk}|.
There exists a real m-by-n matrix ΔA such that LHat·UHat=A+ΔA, with equality of matrices and hence pointwise equality at every entry.
The same ΔA satisfies |ΔA_{ij}|≤n·u·Σ_{r=0}^{n-1}|LHat_{ir}||UHat_{rj}| for every i<m and j<n.
If m=n, the same ΔA additionally satisfies |ΔA_{ij}|≤i·u·Σ_{r=0}^{n-1}|LHat_{ir}||UHat_{rj}| for every i,j.
If m=n, the same ΔA also additionally satisfies |ΔA_{ij}|≤(n-1)·u·Σ_{r=0}^{n-1}|LHat_{ir}||UHat_{rj}| for every i,j.
mathematical_definitions: κ(k) is the row index in Fin m having the same natural value as k∈Fin n; it is well-defined because n≤m.
For 0≤q<n, define S_q(i,j)=Σ_{r=0}^{q}LHat_{ir}UHat_{rj}. This is the exact signed prefix of the matrix-product entry through q.
For 0≤q<n, define P_q(i,j)=Σ_{r=0}^{q}|LHat_{ir}||UHat_{rj}|. This is the corresponding absolute-product prefix.
Define (|LHat||UHat|)_{ij}=Σ_{r=0}^{n-1}|LHat_{ir}||UHat_{rj}|; the notation denotes a componentwise absolute matrix product, not a matrix norm.
All coefficients k, k+1, i, n, and n-1 in real inequalities are cast exactly from natural numbers to real numbers. Natural n-1 is truncated subtraction, though 0<n makes it the ordinary predecessor.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every certified floating-point run producing a unit lower-trapezoidal factor LHat and an upper-triangular factor UHat for an m-by-n matrix A, with 0<n≤m, the residual in each computed upper entry UHat_{kj} is bounded by k times the unit roundoff times the absolute prefix product through k, while the residual in each computed lower entry LHat_{ik} is bounded by k+1 times the unit roundoff times its absolute prefix product. Moreover, there is one componentwise perturbation ΔA for which the computed factors exactly factor A+ΔA. Every perturbation entry is bounded by n times the unit roundoff times the corresponding entry of |LHat||UHat|. In the square case, that same perturbation simultaneously obeys the sharper row-dependent coefficient i and the uniform coefficient n-1.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The proposition does not assert that a run exists for arbitrary m,n or arbitrary matrices. It quantifies only over inhabitants of the run type, so it is vacuous for dimensions or data admitting no such certified run.
Because a run contains proofs of 0<n and n≤m, no run exists when n=0 or m<n.
The first residual family says nothing for pairs with k>j, and the second says nothing for pairs with k≥i; those implications are vacuous when their index antecedents fail.
At k=0, the first bound has coefficient 0 and therefore forces A_{κ(0),j}=LHat_{κ(0),0}UHat_{0j} for every j. In particular, unit diagonal makes this an exact first-row relation.
In the square-case row-dependent bound, i=0 forces ΔA_{0j}=0. If m=n=1, the separate coefficient n-1 is also zero and forces every perturbation entry to vanish.
Both square-case estimates are required simultaneously for the same ΔA; they are not alternative bounds.
The estimates are entrywise absolute-value bounds. No vector norm, matrix norm, relative backward error, or normwise stability statement is encoded.
The target does not assert invertibility of A, uniqueness of the factors, a forward-error bound, conditioning, or a bound on solutions of a linear system.

Admissible runs require representable inputs and factors, nonzero divisors in certified LHat computations, safe products, safe rounded additions, and safe divisions. The proposition gives no claim for executions outside those safe-range conditions.

The execution permits arbitrary summand permutations and arbitrary nonempty binary summation trees, but only when the corresponding representability, safe-range, and inductive error certificates are supplied.

The factor structure is encoded: LHat is zero above its diagonal and has diagonal entries 1 on the first n rows, while UHat is zero below its diagonal. The theorem is not stated for unrestricted pairs of matrices.
No denominator-corrected constants such as γ_n=u n/(1-u n) are present; the coefficients are exactly k, k+1, n, i, and n-1.
